content:
Alex K: noticed a spike in tokenization failures for requests hitting model v3.1 in eu-west1, error rate ~4.2% over last 10m. INC-9876 opened. Repro steps in PR: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/1234. Proposing emergency patch release 3.1.1 -> picks up tokenizer fix. Need expedited approval for a short-window deploy and a model-version pin to avoid rolling new tokenizers.
SRE Oncall: can you summarise blast radius and rollback plan?
Alex K: blast radius = generation only (no embeddings), affects ~1.8% of traffic. Rollback plan: automatic fallback to v3.0 via routing config if error rate >2% during canary; manual rollforward to 3.1.1 if canary stable. Logs/alerts wired to #incidents.
Maria P: I'm +1 for a constrained canary. Request: start at 5% for 10m, check token error rate, latency, and 50/95 p99 tails. If green, step to 25% for 15m then 100%.
Priya S: we should pin model variant to v2-quant for customers on reserved capacity during rollout to avoid mixed tokenizer families. Can ops add a routing pin?
Alex K: yes, plan includes a per-customer routing tag for reserved pools. Patch includes config snippet:```yaml
traffic_policy:
  canary: 0.05
  canary_checks:
    token_error_rate: 0.02
    latency_p95_ms: 400
  pin_reserved: "v2-quant"
```
Jamie L: PR has a short release notes blurb I wrote, adding here: "Fix tokenizer regression that caused intermittent tokenization errors in long-form generation. Backwards-compatible; no prompt changes required." Can we include that in the deploy description?
Ops Lead: need a second PM/Eng manager signoff for expedited window outside normal change window. Maria, can you or @EngManager confirm?
Maria P: I can approve conditionally if canary + auto-fallback is in place and SRE oncall monitors for first 30m. +1 :thumbsup:
SRE Oncall: monitoring hooks set. I'll watch the dashboards and escalate immediately.
Alex K: ok submitting deploy request to deploy-bot now: `/deploy prod eu-west1 release/3.1.1 --canary 5% --checks token_error_rate,latency_p95 --pin reserved=v2-quant`
deploy-bot: Received deploy request from Alex K for release/3.1.1 to prod eu-west1. Scheduling in expedited window (change-window: 2025-11-11T01:00Z).
deploy-bot: Validation: checksums OK, infra health OK, canary policy attached. Queued for deployment.
Ops Lead: approving expedited window for this release. Logging gate: short notice, but severity justifies.
deploy-bot: Starting canary rollout at 5% (task id: dpl-20251111-01).
Maria P: monitoring canary now. if token_error_rate > 2% rollback immediately.
SRE Oncall: initial 5m metrics: token_error_rate = 0.9%, p95 latency +12ms bump only, no error spikes.
Jamie L: +1 for proceed. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: Canary stable after 10m. Promoting to 25%.
Alex K: pushing release notes and changelog: "3.1.1 - tokenization fix, pinned reserved pools to v2-quant to avoid tokenizer mismatch."
SRE Oncall: 25% check after 15m: token_error_rate = 0.6%, p95 normal, no downstream SLO breaches.
deploy-bot: Rolling to 100% traffic.
deploy-bot: Deploy complete. All targets at 3.1.1.
Priya S: confirmed reserved pools pinned and healthy.
Ops Lead: thanks team — mark INC-9876 resolved pending postmortem if any regressions.
Alex K: will open a short post-deploy note with metrics and # of effected requests. Thanks everyone for quick responses. :rocket:
